name: Renjou Mirai
source:
Biological mother of [url=/c22147]Renjou Nozomu[/url].

She is beautiful and has an outstanding figure, and she looks incredibly youthful even though she is almost 40 years old.

She has a soft demeanor, she is calm and always has a smile on her face.

Her husband died, and she has been raising her son, the protagonist, on her own. She also shows her understanding of the protagonist's research, and she herself participates in his experiments as a subject.

Although she appears to be stable on the outside, she is actually very dependent, relying on her parents during her school days and on her husband after her parents died.

She dotes on the main character, and whenever she sees him, she engages in excessive physical contact with him.

(Translated from [url=https://erogamescape.dyndns.org/~ap2/ero/toukei_kaiseki/character.php?character=15036]Erogamescape[/url].)
